fact: The Data Protection Act, 2024 (Act No. 18 of 2024, gazetted 29 October 2024) continues the Information and Data Protection Commission, names it the national supervisory authority (s.12), provides for the Commissioner's appointment by the President (s.8) and its operational independence (s.10), and requires an annual report (s.18).
title: Data Protection Act, 2024 (Act No. 18 of 2024), Botswana Government Gazette Extraordinary
